name: Verdant Note
summary: At Camp Narache, Verdant Note calls young tauren druids to their training. Sent for Gart Mistrunner, it guides them toward the rites of the Earthmother.

sections.title: A Call to the Path
sections.body: Young tauren gifted in nature receive Verdant Note soon after their trials begin at Red Cloud Mesa. A messenger brings Gart Mistrunner's brief summons to Camp Narache, where each initiate must report to the mentor. Restless spirits and shifting elements trouble Mulgore. The elders need new druids trained quickly.

sections.title: Teachings of the Earthmother
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Gart Mistrunner teaches initiates to commune with nature. He warns that night elves share a bond with the wild, yet ancient pride keeps them distant from tauren. Tauren druidism centers on reverence for the Earthmother. Initiates learn to hear the land's restless ancestral voices and serve as her living instruments.

faq.answer: Verdant Note calls fledgling tauren druids to Camp Narache. It tells them to seek Gart Mistrunner and begin their spiritual training.
A messenger carries Verdant Note on Gart Mistrunner's behalf. Gart trains druids at Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Why is Gart Mistrunner calling for druid initiates?
faq.answer: Restless ancestral spirits trouble Mulgore and nearby regions. Gart needs new druids trained quickly to commune with the wild spirits and heal the disturbed land.

faq.q: What does Gart tell druids regarding the night elves?
faq.answer: Gart warns that night elves share a sacred bond with nature, but their pride makes them unlikely to welcome tauren into their circles. He urges initiates to follow the teachings of the Earthmother.

angles.text: As a druid, Verdant Note marks your acceptance into tauren druidic study and begins your lifelong communion with the Earthmother.
As Shu'halo, your druidism is an ancestral calling tied to healing the balance of your sacred hunting grounds in Mulgore.
